scope: Source-authored experimental cold LPDDR4 MR interface; no hardware actions, normal-boot integration or vendor executable content

primary_reference.title: Rockchip RK3576 TRM Part2 V1.2 20240624
primary_reference.provenance: Rockchip register facts, independently matched controller generation/layout. No Radxa source or derivatives. No Rockchip PHY configuration transplanted.

register_facts.MRCTRL0+080: bit31 trigger, bit24 receive-done clear, bits5:4 rank mask, bit3 software initialization intervention, bit0 read/write
register_facts.MRCTRL1+084: LP4 MR address15:8 and write data7:0
register_facts.MRSTAT+090: bit16 receive-done; bit0 command-busy falls when command issued
register_facts.PWRCTL+180: bit11 software self-refresh request; current held0x800 must be cleared separately before command stage
register_facts.DERATECTL0+100: bit0 automatic MR4 polling enable; command precondition requires disabled

prepare: Check both controllers and reset-held memory before any write; set bit3 in both MRCTRL0 with readback. Two writes only; no command. Caller freezes expected_micro_reset to1 or9, matched exactly; stall must remain asserted and0 is never permitted.
command: Check both channels armed, INIT, no low-power controls, DFI completion, reset high and caller-reviewed pin/timing readiness. MRW returns issued-only. MRR clears stale done, verifies zero, explicitly clears bit24, programs selection/data, triggers separately and requires new done before raw reads.
limitations: Candidate same-generation done/data semantics require T736 hardware confirmation.
No automatic clear of software intervention, rollback, cleanup or retry.
No result proves valid MR bytes, trained DDR or usable memory.

validation.native: cc C11 O2 Wall Wextra Werror Wconversion Wshadow ASan UBSan
validation.tests: 28 arm,42 MRW,48 MRR callback-failure positions; prewrite state corruption; stale/missing/early done; stuck busy/request; both clear-bit behaviors; select/data readback errors; invalid inputs; no callback after failure. All3 operations pass with frozenMicro1 or9; observedMicro0..9 other than expected abort before internalPHY reads; invalid expectedMicro values fail withoutMMIO.
validation.arm: arm-linux-gnueabi-gcc cortex-a55 ARM soft-float mno-unaligned-access O2 freestanding no-builtin; strict warnings pass; no undefined symbols
